morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整人名记忆，通常写作 Priya，不按马来语词缀拆分。IPA 为印地语姓名读法示例，不能代替具体姓名持有人的读音。

senses.zh_definition: 普丽娅：源于梵语、通常用于女性的人名，其名称含义与“亲爱的、受珍爱的”有关。
senses.en_definition: A usually feminine given name of Sanskrit origin, meaning beloved.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi, lazimnya nama perempuan, yang berasal daripada bahasa Sanskrit dan membawa makna yang dikasihi.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 指专有名词。这是姓名释义，不是已核实的 DBP 马来语普通词释义。中文译名可因本人习惯而异；以下为自然称呼或组合示例，并非有频率证据的固定搭配。[Priya：姓名来源与印地语读音](https://www.behindthename.com/name/priya)

dual_scenarios.ms: Priya akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: Priya 将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Priya will present the project progress report at tomorrow’s meeting.

messages.speaker: Priya (熟悉的同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum, nak makan kat bawah je. Jom!
messages.ms_standard: Belum. Saya hendak makan di tingkat bawah sahaja. Mari kita pergi bersama-sama.
messages.zh: 还没，打算就在楼下吃。一起吧！
messages.en: Not yet. I’m just going to eat downstairs. Come along!

etymology.historical_story: Priya belongs to a naming tradition connected with Sanskrit priya, a word expressing dearness, affection, or being cherished. The name is used across several South Asian languages. This history explains its association with being beloved, but does not turn a person’s name into a Malay adjective or establish that person’s religion. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/priya) [Sanskrit dictionary](https://www.sanskrit-lexicon.uni-koeln.de/scans/MWScan/MWScanpdf/mw0710-priya.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Priya → a dear person → 受珍爱的人；这是姓名含义联想，实际称呼保留本人名字。
